fields.description: Silva combines one to three bedroom apartments with three bedroom townhouses in Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour. The residences have private outdoor space, while the wider setting brings together parks, sports areas and waterfront routes. Its townhouse layouts spread living spaces across three levels rather than following the apartment arrangement.
amenities: Green Gate running and recreation spaces

overview: Silva’s brochure uses a restrained, earthy interior palette and places the development within Green Gate’s landscape-led neighbourhood. The broader plan includes a central plaza, running routes, lawns, play and sports spaces, with retail and dining nearby. These are community proposals rather than a promise that every facility is inside the building or already open. The brochure also refers to future transport improvements; an eventual connection should not replace a check of today’s commute.
research.locationNote: Silva is in the Green Gate neighbourhood of Dubai Creek Harbour. Creekside routes and the wider waterfront community form its setting. Confirm the selected home’s orientation, outlook and actual walking route to facilities; published travel times are estimates.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s page displays AED 1,824,888 as its units-from figure on the research date. This differs from historical launch pricing and is not evidence of remaining stock. Request a current quotation for a specific unit.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule allocates 10% on booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Several scheduled dates are already past. The remaining obligations for a purchase today depend on the unit and signed agreement.
research.handoverNote: September 2029 is the launch sheet’s estimated construction-completion date and is also reported by Property Finder. It is not confirmation of a contractual key-handover date or current construction progress.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: Silva’s launch sheet lists 434 homes: 189 one bedroom, 186 two bedroom and 48 three bedroom apartments, plus 11 three bedroom townhouses. These are launch counts, not current availability.

facts.label: Historical type prices
facts.value: Launch starting prices were AED 1.79 million, AED 2.65 million and AED 3.87 million for one to three bedroom apartments; three bedroom townhouses started at AED 6.31 million.

facts.label: Building and area basis
facts.value: The plan pack identifies B+G+2P+47. Apartment totals include balconies or terraces; quoted total area is not the same as enclosed living space.

facts.label: Townhouse layout
facts.value: The two reviewed townhouse types have a 2,328.23 sq ft suite plus 925.05–937.11 sq ft of outdoor area. Ground and two podium levels include a maid’s room, several living spaces and a roof-level terrace.

unresolved: The launch sheet’s 740 sq ft minimum for one bedroom apartments is below the smallest layout in the reviewed official pack; further unit drawings are needed to explain the difference.
